page.overview:
Who is Class President?

An unnamed high school student was the class president of Asa Mitaka's class at Fourth East High School who allegedly made a contract with the "Justice Devil" out of jealousy. She is the secondary antagonist of the Justice Devil arc.

The class president was a high school girl of average height and build. She had short light-colored hair that did not reach her shoulders with a hair clip.

Her contract allows her to transform into a towering, blob-like creature supported by two giant hands, with her lower body protruding from the bottom and hanging in the air, and multiple replicas of her face at the top.

Originally, she appeared to be mild-mannered and supportive, such as when she sought out and consoled Asa Mitaka after their class was given Bucky. In reality, she was delusional, presumptuous and narcissistic, believing that Asa was having a sexual relationship with their teacher, Mr. Tanaka, whom she herself had been having a sexual relationship with.
